instruments.name: Bright Grand
instruments.description: A bright synth stand-in for a grand piano with a ringing strike and a deep low end, for a featured piano part that cuts through a mix.

instruments.name: Musette Accordion
instruments.description: Two reeds a few cents apart for the wheezy, shimmering French accordion, for cafés, waltzes, and sea shanties.

instruments.name: LinnDrum 80s
instruments.description: An 80s drum-machine kit with a punchy kick and hard snare, a clap and a gritty digital snare, choking hats, four sweeping Simmons toms, tambourine, cabasa, cowbell, and conga.

instruments.name: Sub Bass (Ievan Polkka)
instruments.description: A deep sine with a gentle lowpass sweep, felt more than heard under the rest of the mix.

instruments.name: Warm Bass (Ievan Polkka)
instruments.description: Deep, woolly low voice with a soft swoop into each note.

instruments.name: Soprano (Ievan Polkka)
instruments.description: Light, high female voice with a quick shimmering vibrato.
